description: Pay for a booking (付款) whose status is awaiting_payment, with a payment credential the customer approved for the booking's amount and currency. payment.handler_id must come from the booking's payment_handlers ("stripe_payments"), and credential is {type: "stripe_payment_token", token: "spt_…"}: a Stripe shared payment token issued to the handler's business_profile. Charges the customer once (repeating the call does not charge twice). Returns the booking (confirmed, or pending if the business confirms it) and the payment result; if payment.status is requires_action, open payment.redirect_url for the customer and call again with the same credential.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key (8–64 letters, digits, _ . : -) that makes retries safe: the same key with the same parameters returns the original result

token.description: Stripe shared payment token, e.g. spt_…

name: complete_booking
title: Pay for a booking
